content:
hana: FYI  embassy courier delivering sealed archival box for visiting researcher (Dr. Kim) at 10:30. Box requires signed receipt + ID verification and the visitor may need a quiet seating area while paperwork is completed. Also asks if we can hold a small box of pastries (sealed) for after.

frontdesk-bot: Visitor scheduled: Dr. S. Kim (guest of hana), ETA 10:30, host: hana. Courier: Embassy Courier. Check-in: https://intranet/checkin/emb345

mike: Quick notes: 1) If the box is sealed by embassy, do not open on site. 2) Require government ID and org letter for Dr. Kim to sign acceptance. 3) We need a stamped receipt pad (we have one at front desk).

darya: We have a downstairs notarization stamp kit if the courier needs an attest. But confirm with host first. For seating: small quiet chair in north alcove reserved 10:20:00.

leo: For packages: front desk should note courier BOL number and add "sealed archival box - do not open" on the delivery log. If guest needs to store sealed box briefly, we can badge-lock Guest Locker A1 for 10:30:30. Ops OK?

ops: Ops: Guest Locker A1 available 10:30:30. Approved to badge-lock. Please have host sign chain-of-custody and record courier BOL and ID number.

sara: PS re: pastries: sealed pastries ok in common fridge. If any are to be shared publicly, please check for nut-free labeling (we have a team member with severe nut allergy).

hana: Thanks all  I'll message the courier asking for BOL in advance and confirm Dr. Kim will bring ID and the host org letter. Can someone add a 5-step check-in snippet for this flow?

mike: Draft check-in snippet: 1) Verify courier BOL & embassy seal, note BOL number. 2) Ask visitor for government ID + host org letter, take photo of ID (if permitted). 3) Print badge: add note "sealed archival box in A1 locker". 4) Have host sign chain-of-custody pad and stamp receipt. 5) If pastry present: label and place in common fridge; if unsealed, hand to host only.

darya: Copying snippet into the front desk playbook and adding an "embassy delivery" tag. Also flagging the badge printer to add the locker note automatically when "sealed archival" phrase is used.

frontdesk-bot: Action: Reserved Guest Locker A1 10:30-11:30. Badge-note template updated.

hana: One more: Dr. Kim asked about a quiet place to do a short video call while waiting for the courier paperwork (5-10 min). Is a hush booth free?

leo: Hush Booth C free 10:15:45. Reserved for them. I'll add a sign: "Reserved for visitor 10:15-10:45" and a soft chair in the alcove if needed.

ops: Reminder: do not accept any sealed box marked "classified" or with hazardous labels. If courier presents such labels, call security.

sara: Allergies note added to calendar and pastry note: "nut-free only pls".

hana: Perfect. I'll confirm with the courier and Dr. Kim and update thread if ETA shifts. Thank you everyone! :heart:
